title: Your apps wind you up. DeRot brings you back down. And it's almost here.

copy.threads_text:
Your apps wind you up. DeRot brings you back down. And it's almost here.

We pause your apps while you reset with a few calming breaths, then send you back calmer.

Coming soon to iPhone. Join the launch list and we'll tell you the day it's live:
